item.title: Maddock: John James 'disappointing' Trump by staying in governor's race
item.description: President Donald Trump is pressuring U.S. Rep. John James to abandon his run for Michigan governor and instead seek reelection to Congress, a move Trump allies say is key to maintaining Republican control of the House of Representatives.
